verdict.rationale: 2FAS publishes code on GitHub. It invites code review and contributions, and it describes 2FAS Auth as "open-source" in its llms.txt and its auth.md mirror. 2FAS Pass is described only as "source-available," which may not mean an open license. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named, Pass's source is only called source-available, and there is no independent confirmation of the license terms.
